mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate level signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 330.0 indicates accelerating inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (CPIAUCSL > 330.0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and declines in unemployment (UNRATE) signal robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings outlook.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong employment conditions support corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, typically leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising (month-over-month) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (INDPRO < 100.0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 330.0) and weak retail sales (RSAFS < 700000) signal stagflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate margins face squeeze.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL > 330.0 and RSAFS < 700000) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0), manufacturing weakness leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
